name: ci
label: GitHub Actions CI
description: A workflow running lint, format, typecheck and the Testcontainers-backed test suite on every push and pull request.
notes: The workflow needs package-lock.json committed; the .gitignore shipped by core deliberately does not exclude it.
No `services:` block: Testcontainers provisions and disposes of its own PostgreSQL, and hosted Ubuntu runners already have Docker.
JWT_ACCESS_SECRET is set inline as a throwaway CI value; every other variable either has a default or is supplied by the test harness.
